name: OGC API - Connected Systems Building Blocks
abstract: Data models of the OGC API - Connected Systems standard and its underlying SWE Common 3.0 and SensorML 3.0 encodings, as reusable building blocks.
description:
Draft conversion of the JSON schemas maintained in [opengeospatial/ogcapi-connected-systems](https://github.com/opengeospatial/ogcapi-connected-systems)
into building blocks. Scope is limited to data models (no OpenAPI paths/parameters, no XML encodings).
Semantic annotations (JSON-LD contexts) are not yet provided.

bblocks.name: Link
bblocks.abstract: Link object following standard Web Linking conventions (see RFC5988 and RFC6690)

bblocks.name: TimeInstant
bblocks.abstract: Time Instant

bblocks.name: Batch_delete
bblocks.abstract: Request payload for batch deletion of resources, given as a list of resource URIs, local IDs or unique identifiers (UIDs).

bblocks.name: Batch_response
bblocks.abstract: Response describing the outcome of a batch create, update or delete operation, reporting the per-item result of each request.

bblocks.name: Uris
bblocks.abstract: Enumerations of the allowed type URIs (from the SSN/SOSA and Connected Systems vocabularies) for System, Deployment and Procedure features.

bblocks.name: CommandStatusCode
bblocks.abstract: Enumeration of the status codes a Command can report, such as pending, accepted, executing, completed, failed or rejected.

bblocks.name: CommandSchemaAnyOther
bblocks.abstract: Command schema for any other command format, identified by `commandFormat` and carrying free-form schema properties.

bblocks.name: ObservationSchemaAnyOther
bblocks.abstract: Observation schema for any other observation format, identified by `obsFormat` and carrying free-form schema properties.

bblocks.name: Pose
bblocks.abstract: A Pose object that can be either a GeoPose Basic instance of a relative pose.

bblocks.name: Matrix
bblocks.abstract: Implementation of ISO-11404 Array datatype. This defines an array of identical data components with a elementCount. Values are given as a block and can be encoded in different ways

bblocks.name: LegalConstraint
bblocks.abstract: LegalConstraint schema.

bblocks.name: ResponsibleParty
bblocks.abstract: ResponsibleParty schema.

bblocks.name: AbstractSimpleComponent
bblocks.abstract: AbstractSimpleComponent schema.

bblocks.name: Links
bblocks.abstract: Collection (array) of link objects pointing to related resources, following the OGC API Common link model.

bblocks.name: CommandSchemaProtobuf
bblocks.abstract: Command schema for the Protobuf format, describing command parameters using a Protobuf message definition.

bblocks.name: ObservationSchemaProtobuf
bblocks.abstract: Observation schema for the Protobuf format, describing the observation record using a Protobuf message definition.

bblocks.name: ContactLink
bblocks.abstract: ContactLink schema.

bblocks.name: Document
bblocks.abstract: Document schema.

bblocks.name: TimeInstantOrNow
bblocks.abstract: Time Instant

bblocks.name: Observation
bblocks.abstract: An Observation: the result of observing a property of a feature of interest at a given time, produced by a System and stored in a DataStream.

bblocks.name: BasicTypes
bblocks.abstract: BasicTypes schema.

bblocks.name: Boolean
bblocks.abstract: Scalar component used to express truth: True or False, 0 or 1

bblocks.name: DeployedSystem (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: A deployed System (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): a system as listed within a Deployment, tying it to its installation in that deployment.

bblocks.name: Feature (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Generic GeoJSON feature used as the base of the Connected Systems feature resources, with local `id`, `geometry`, `bbox`, free-form `properties` and `links`.

bblocks.name: TimePeriod
bblocks.abstract: Time Period

bblocks.name: ObservationCollection
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of Observation resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: AbstractSweIdentifiable
bblocks.abstract: Base substitution groups for all SWE Common objects with identification metadata

bblocks.name: Category
bblocks.abstract: Scalar component used to represent a categorical value as a simple token identifying a term in a code space

bblocks.name: CategoryRange
bblocks.abstract: Pair of categorical values used to specify a range in an ordinal reference system (specified by the code space)

bblocks.name: Count
bblocks.abstract: Scalar component with integer representation used for a discrete counting value

bblocks.name: CountRange
bblocks.abstract: Integer pair used for specifying a count range

bblocks.name: Encodings
bblocks.abstract: Encodings schema.

bblocks.name: Quantity
bblocks.abstract: Scalar component with decimal representation and a unit of measure used to store value of a continuous quantity

bblocks.name: QuantityRange
bblocks.abstract: Decimal pair for specifying a quantity range with a unit of measure

bblocks.name: Text
bblocks.abstract: Free text component used to store comments or any other type of textual statement

bblocks.name: Time
bblocks.abstract: Scalar component used to represent a time quantity either as ISO 8601 (e.g., 2004-04-18T12:03:04.6Z) or as a duration relative to a time of reference

bblocks.name: TimeRange
bblocks.abstract: Time value pair for specifying a time range (can be a decimal or ISO 8601)

bblocks.name: DeployedSystemArray (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Bare JSON array of deployed System resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.

bblocks.name: Procedure (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: A Procedure (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): a specification of how observations are made or commands are executed, such as a sensor datasheet, method or protocol that systems implement.

bblocks.name: Deployment (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: A Deployment (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): the installation of one or more systems at a location and time, describing where and when they operate.

bblocks.name: SamplingFeature (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: A Sampling Feature (GeoJSON encoding): a feature such as a station, specimen or transect that is sampled or observed by systems, and serves as the feature of interest of observations; profile of the OGC API - Features feature.

bblocks.name: System (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: A System (GeoJSON encoding, a profile of the OGC API - Features feature): a sensor, actuator, platform, sampler or other asset that produces observations or receives commands, with its identity, type and relationships to other resources.

bblocks.name: BaseStream
bblocks.abstract: Properties shared by DataStream and ControlStream resources: local ID, name, description, valid time and the list of supported encoding formats.

bblocks.name: Command
bblocks.abstract: A Command: a request sent through a ControlStream to a System to perform an action, carrying its parameters, issue time and execution constraints.

bblocks.name: CommandResult
bblocks.abstract: A CommandResult: a result resource produced by the execution of a Command, linked to it by `command@id` and carrying inline data or a reference to the result.

bblocks.name: AbstractDataComponent
bblocks.abstract: Abstract base class for all data components

bblocks.name: DataStream
bblocks.abstract: Defines the structure of the element that will be repeated in the stream

bblocks.name: DeployedSystemCollection (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of deployed System resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: ProcedureArray (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Bare JSON array of Procedure resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.

bblocks.name: DeploymentArray (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Bare JSON array of Deployment resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.

bblocks.name: SamplingFeatureArray (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Bare JSON array of Sampling Feature resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update.

bblocks.name: SystemArray (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Bare JSON array of System resources (GeoJSON encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update of several resources at once.

bblocks.name: CommandCollection
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of Command resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: CommandResultCollection
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of CommandResult resources as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: CommandStatus
bblocks.abstract: A CommandStatus report: the state of execution of a Command at a given report time, with status code, percent completion, message and any results.

bblocks.name: DataRecord
bblocks.abstract: Implementation of ISO-11404 Record datatype. This allows grouping (sequence) of data components which can themselves be simple types, records, arrays or choices

bblocks.name: Geometry
bblocks.abstract: Implementation of ISO-19107 geometry datatype. This allows embedding a geometry in a larger schema

bblocks.name: Vector
bblocks.abstract: Implementation of a mathematical vector composed of a list of scalar coordinates expressed in the mandatory reference frame.

bblocks.name: ProcedureCollection (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of Procedure resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: DeploymentCollection (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of Deployment resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: SamplingFeatureCollection (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of Sampling Feature resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: SystemCollection (GeoJSON)
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of System resources (GeoJSON encoding) as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: CommandStatusCollection
bblocks.abstract: Paged collection of CommandStatus reports as returned by list queries, with the items plus navigation `links`.

bblocks.name: SweCommon
bblocks.abstract: SweCommon schema.

bblocks.name: CommandSchemaJson
bblocks.abstract: Command schema for the JSON format (`application/json`), defining the `parametersSchema` and optional result and feasibility result schemas with SWE Common components.

bblocks.name: CommandSchemaSwe
bblocks.abstract: Command schema for SWE Common encodings (text, binary, etc.), giving the record schema and encoding rules of the command stream.

bblocks.name: DataStreamSchemaDef
bblocks.abstract: Schema definition of the observation record of a DataStream, describing phenomenon time, result time, feature of interest, result and parameters with SWE Common components.

bblocks.name: ObservationSchemaJson
bblocks.abstract: Observation schema for the JSON format (`application/json`), describing the observation result, parameters and related fields with SWE Common components.

bblocks.name: ObservationSchemaSwe
bblocks.abstract: Observation schema for SWE Common encodings (text, binary, etc.), giving the record schema and the encoding rules of the observation stream.

bblocks.name: DerivedProperty
bblocks.abstract: DerivedProperty schema.

bblocks.name: DataArray
bblocks.abstract: Implementation of ISO-11404 Array datatype. This defines an array of identical data components with a elementCount. Values are given as a block and can be encoded in different ways

bblocks.name: DataChoice
bblocks.abstract: Implementation of a choice of two or more Data Components (also called disjoint union)

bblocks.name: CommandSchema
bblocks.abstract: Schema describing the content of commands in a ControlStream; the syntax depends on the command format (JSON, SWE, Protobuf or other).

bblocks.name: ObservationSchema
bblocks.abstract: Schema describing the content of observations in a DataStream; the syntax depends on the observation format (JSON, SWE, Protobuf or other).

bblocks.name: Property (SensorML)
bblocks.abstract: A Property (SensorML 3.0 JSON encoding): a definition of an observable or controllable property (e.g. temperature, wind speed) that systems and procedures can reference.

bblocks.name: Common Definitions
bblocks.abstract: Definitions shared by SensorML schemas: observable properties, terms, any-property and any-constraint unions, path references and time instant-or-period.

bblocks.name: ControlStream
bblocks.abstract: A ControlStream: a channel through which commands are sent to a controllable System, describing the supported command parameters, result schema and formats.

bblocks.name: DataStream
bblocks.abstract: A DataStream: a time-ordered stream of observations produced by a System, describing the observed properties, result schema and formats. Observations are posted to and retrieved from it.

bblocks.name: PropertyArray (SensorML)
bblocks.abstract: Bare JSON array of Property resources (SensorML encoding), used as the request payload for batch creation or update.

bblocks.name: Settings
